title: Jazz Technique Class | Improve Turns, Kicks, and Leaps from Home

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher provides clear, step-by-step instructions while demonstrating the movements herself. She emphasizes proper technique and body alignment throughout the lesson.

lesson_structure.note: The teacher introduces the jazz technique class.
The teacher leads a warmup with jumping jacks and jogging in place.
The teacher leads a series of plies and stretches.
The teacher leads squats with twists and side lunges.
The teacher leads a light stretch for the hamstrings and hips.
The teacher leads a sumo squat stretch.
The teacher leads a forward fold stretch.
The teacher leads a pyramid stretch.
The teacher leads a runner's lunge and hip flexor stretch.
The teacher leads a first position plié exercise.

common_mistakes: pitching forward during a sumo squat
leaning back during a sumo squat
crunched up back during a pyramid stretch

steps_taught.name: Jumping Jacks
steps_taught.description: A full-body exercise involving jumping with legs apart and arms overhead.

steps_taught.name: Plié
steps_taught.description: A bending of the knees while keeping the back straight.

steps_taught.name: Sumo Squat
steps_taught.description: A wide-stance squat with knees pointing outward.

steps_taught.name: Runner's Lunge
steps_taught.description: A deep lunge with one leg forward and the other extended back.

what_works: The teacher provides clear, step-by-step instructions.
The teacher demonstrates the movements herself.
what_hinders: The video lacks a variety of camera angles.

quotes.text: I'm going to do my best to teach this as if you were right here.
Okay, let's get our blood flowing, our heart pumping a little faster.
You should probably save that for after you're done with all of your movement.
Make sure that you are straight down here. You're not pitched forward.
Just let gravity pull you down. And make sure you're breathing.

evidence_segments.observation: The teacher stands in front of the camera and explains the class structure.
The teacher performs jumping jacks with arms and legs moving in unison.
The teacher performs a series of pliés with arms extended to the side.
The teacher performs a flat-back forward fold with arms extended to the side.
The teacher performs side lunges with hands clasped in front of the chest.
The teacher performs a sumo squat with hands on her knees.

extraction.distinctive_method: The teacher uses a 'waiting list' for her upcoming dance technique course as a way to engage her audience.
